profile_text.body:
Coursera is a public company, traded as COUR, founded in 2012 and headquartered in Mountain View, California. Its site describes an online learning platform offering courses, Professional Certificates, Specializations, and degrees, with content from organizations including Google, Meta, Anthropic, DeepLearning.AI, and Stanford. The company describes its certificates as providing job-ready skills and verifiable credentials, and it sells Coursera Plus, an annual subscription giving unlimited access to thousands of courses, Specializations, and Professional Certificates.

The site names programs in AI, data science, cybersecurity, and software engineering, including the Machine Learning Specialization, the Deep Learning Specialization, the AI Essentials Specialization, the AI Engineer Professional Certificate, the Google Project Management Professional Certificate, the Google UX Design Professional Certificate, the Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate, the IBM Data Science Professional Certificate, the IBM Data Analyst Professional Certificate, the Data Analysis with Python Specialization, and the UI/UX Design Specialization. It also points learners to broader areas such as artificial intelligence, SQL, and web development.

The company's record shows a CIK of 0001651562, consistent with its status as a public company. It has 281 cases recorded in California. No products or MCP servers are listed for it.
